data_gate.retain_attribution: Every result retains data/words/PINS.json attribution and hashes of fill/plan/template sources.
data_gate.approved_code_only: Data are read with python -I -B; no fetched PR content is imported or executed.

incoming_lane.S6: Confirmed NULL on both seeds per coordinator; no zero-slack binding intervals.

order.description: Recheck P3 literal role/time/family/offset/prefix/profile parity on all three held fills; sink-DAG audit; retain P1 exact per-chain conservation receipts on at least three held words.
Primary #2802 base and extra; optional predeclared family-local #2751 base replication only if primary work and registered CPU budget permit.

order.condition: Run only if the sandpile lane remains open under PLAN section6.
order.description: Independent pilot versus initial local-walk slope on each held fill.

order.condition: Run only if the sandpile lane remains open and its registered budget permits.
order.description: Exact assignment confluence on ten specified helper-width perturbations; valid-word utility remains unresolved without authentic changed local words.

audit.inherited_1672_metadata: Audit the original provider-profile/fill parity separately from the held-word overlay. A documented provider-profile mismatch does not itself mean roles or literal fill rules are inexact.
audit.dag: call(time,0) -> window(stop,1), ordered lexicographically; all eligibility arcs increase this order.
audit.group_burning_identity: Remain dropped: no intrinsic Laplacian or toppling operator is supplied.

S2.replication_scope: BORROW-WORD family-local only; optional third word does not change the two primary-word criteria.
S2.start: Upper-bound labeling U of the exact FrameSampler graph.
S2.order_protocol: At each sweep shuffle mutable gates; at a gate choose uniformly among legal proper subspaces nested below its current frame whose exact rational cost-delta upper bound is negative. Finish after a full sweep makes no move.
S2.randomness: SHA256 of experiment, seed, immutable word identifiers, and order index. Batching and worker scheduling cannot change an order stream.
S2.sign_certificate: Evaluate a rational lower and upper bound for EVERY legal nonzero profile delta. An interval straddling zero is unresolved. Any unresolved sign blocks a positive verdict; unresolved signs at the terminal block maximality certification.
S2.reference: One exact toolkit integer-surrogate solve plus rational true-minimum interval per word, outside all random-order loops; add unchanged centre descents consistently.
S2.original_bar: >=95 of 100 terminal profiles equal the certified reference profile, separately for each primary word and each seed.

status_rules.reference_agreement_subtest: PASS iff at least95/100 profiles equal the certified integer-surrogate profile; otherwise NULL for this profile-agreement subtest only.
status_rules.overall_PASS: Requires original bar, resolved true-cost signs and maximality, and an independently established true-optimum reference profile. A nonzero true-minimum interval alone does not establish the last obligation.
status_rules.overall_NULL: >5/100 individually certified maximal terminals have true-cost lower bounds strictly greater than a feasible reference upper bound, falsifying the >=95/100 true-optimum bar. Unresolved signs in other orders remain reported and do not invalidate those individual counterexamples.
status_rules.overall_EXPLORATORY: Includes surrogate-reference agreement without a true-optimum-profile certificate, unresolved local signs, or unresolved terminal comparisons.
status_rules.incomplete: ERROR/TIMEOUT or EXPLORATORY with exact completed IDs; never reduce the denominator.

S2.potential: Sum of mutable frame dimensions strictly decreases and is integer-bounded below. This proves termination only; it does not prove confluence or abelianity.

budgets.replication: Only after both primary words' two-seed work, from the same remaining registered budget; if unavailable, report skipped/TIMEOUT rather than claim three-word replication.

api.checkpoint: Prefer one order per pool task; grouping is allowed only before launch and must not alter seeds. Exactly unique order IDs0..99 are required.

S4.pilot: Independent random stream, proposals evaluated at the unchanged literal fill.
S4.transition: Choose a role uniformly, release it, try up to60 random eligible-window/port destinations; accept only capacity- and family-feasible destinations; otherwise restore. Track attempted and changed moves separately.
S4.prediction: Mean pilot split/merge moment delta at the literal root, divided by the negative full-profile moment derivative.
original_bars: Initial observed root-decay slope within10% of the independent prediction on EVERY held fill.
Original clumping >=0.75 on EVERY held fill.
Both independent seeds reproduce the decision.
S4.zero_prediction: EXPLORATORY because relative error is undefined; serialize null rather than Infinity.
S4.final_check: Rebuild compact offsets and independently audit every literal fill rule.
S4.inherited_1672_scope: Use the explicitly identified held-word local-profile overlay at unchanged helper widths; keep inherited provider metadata visible.

S5.original_scope: #2802 helper-width perturbations, 8->9 or9->8 on one helper label in every call.
S5.perturbation_selection: Five lowest helper-role labels whose width is8 in every call, then five lowest labels whose width is9 in every call; selection is fixed before outcomes.
S5.repair_rule: Start from the original owner assignments with the changed width. Choose overflowing bins in random order and their roles in random order; push one chosen role into a uniformly sampled eligible destination satisfying capacity and per-call family uniqueness. Use64 rejection samples then exhaustive uniform-reservoir fallback. If all overflowing bins and roles lack a destination, record locally stuck; do not infer global infeasibility.
S5.termination: Every successful move strictly lowers total positive integer overflow; no move creates a newly overflowing destination.
S5.primary_bar: >=95/100 feasible terminals have the same exact canonical role assignment, separately for every perturbation and seed.
S5.terminal_identity: Canonical sorted (time,helper,owner,child,port,offset) records; offsets are rebuilt in (time,helper) order. Profile equality is secondary and cannot replace exact assignment equality.
S5.original_utility_bar: Repair within1e-8 kappa of the exact rehost on>=90% of perturbations, i.e.>=9/10.
S5.sufficient_utility_certificate: Prespecify>=90/100 rigorously close orders as a sufficient condition for a perturbation;>=9/10 such perturbations suffices. Failure of this stronger certificate is EXPLORATORY, never a false utility NULL.
S5.reference: One rationally certified bin-pattern LP ceiling per distinct width-inventory/local-profile relaxation, shared across the five identical inventory changes in each direction; no solver inside order loops. A feasible terminal root lower bound within1e-8 of a valid relaxation ceiling suffices without an exact primal rehost.
S5.missing_valid_word_profile: No authentic changed local word/profile is supplied for these width edits. Add/remove one rank-1 local child per affected call solely as an explicit counterfactual mass closure. Full-profile root brackets under this closure are diagnostic, and original width-edit utility remains EXPLORATORY.
S5.ledger: Signed width-mass change equals signed local paid-rank-mass change; idle mass changes oppositely; global rank mass is preserved. Retain source attribution and label the closure in every perturbation.

status_rules.primary_failure: A complete100-order perturbation with fewer than95 identical feasible assignments fails the primary. Main family NULL requires the registered complete family as implemented.
status_rules.primary_pass_missing_utility: EXPLORATORY with primary PASS; no invented valid-word or kappa claim.
status_rules.unresolved_reference: EXPLORATORY utility; never infer failure from a loose relaxation.

S5.optional_secondary_placement_control: Implemented separately as prepare_placement_control; not included in the primary family and must be independently preregistered before running. It preserves widths/local profile and cannot answer width-edit utility.

api.parent: sandpile.prepare_s5() -> ten starts and distinct reference indices; heavy fill loaded once.

execution.parent_loading: Load word graphs or large fill/plan/template objects once in the parent; run separate pool parents if simultaneous inherited objects exceed projection.
execution.memory_projection: Write projected peak and per-worker working set before every launch; abort unsafe projections.
execution.checkpoint: RESULT.json per run, pool receipt per task, exact sample IDs, reference receipt, script SHA256, source blobs, wall/CPU/RSS accounting.
execution.solver_bound: No solver call exceeds600s; all reference solvers are outside permutation/order loops.
execution.budget: Coordinator enforces CPU budgets from checkpointed task receipts; an incomplete prescribed family yields TIMEOUT with no denominator reduction or significance claim.
execution.decisions: A decision stands only when the second seed reproduces it; update EXPERIMENTS.json.

stop_rules.inexact_fill: If actual role/rule conservation or literal idle parity fails, the sandpile mapping is heuristic and only one heuristic experiment is allowed; group/burning items remain dropped.
stop_rules.two_nulls: Two consecutive preregistered scientific NULL experiments stop the sandpile lane. With incoming S6 NULL, confirmed S2 NULL stops S4 and S5. If S2 is non-null but S4 becomes a second consecutive NULL under the recorded sequence, stop before S5.
stop_rules.not_null: ERROR, TIMEOUT, EXPLORATORY, metadata provenance caveats, and prerequisite bookkeeping are not scientific NULLs.
stop_rules.not_a_skip_reason: Missing implementation is not a scientific stop rule; S5 source is supplied.
stop_rules.whole_plan: Hard stop at the end of week2 from coordinator kick-off; deliver protocol-specific nulls and unresolved items.

pattern_criteria.replication: At least3 words including both families, or explicitly family-local with at least3 words of that family.
pattern_criteria.matched_null: Sandpile invariant outside the central99% of the matched null on each word.
pattern_criteria.held_out: Pass a word not used to find the pattern, opened only at M4.
pattern_criteria.noncircular: Move under an N2 sample; functions only of local profile, rank mass, or width inventory are restatements.
pattern_criteria.finite_order_tests: S2/S5 sample counts are protocol bars, not n>=2000 permutation significance tests. No p/q value or pattern claim is manufactured from100 orders.
